summary: 1. 2026-10-02 (manual restructure, Peter's request) -- RAW folders reorganized: 28 top-level folders down to 17, typos fixed, citations and tasks updated Follows the safe clean-up earlier today. 2. Peter asked for the full restructure plus citation and nightly-compile updates. 3. RAW holds 1,166 files before and after; every file was verified at its mapped new path, none renamed or deleted. `PATH-MAP.md` (KB root) lists every old-to-new path, and `_TIDY_HOLD/2026-10-02-restructure/file-map.json` maps each file. 4. What changed Typos fixed: `Maintanance Shedules` is now `Maintenance Schedules` (it also absorbed `Friday Works - Manitanance` as `Friday Works`); `Quartely Production Inspection` is now `Quarterly Production Inspection`. 5. Merged: `Safety Report`, `Incidents report`, `NCR`, `RA/RA`, `RA/MOC`, `LSR`, `PTO`, `Maaden Induction` and `Audit - Internal Phase 1 - 2026` now sit under `Safety & Compliance/`. `SOP`, `SWI` and the four loose files in `Procedures` now sit under `Procedures/` (`SOP`, `SWI`, `General`). `Training` is now `HR/Training`. 6. Maaden Plans: 19 weekly folders now under `Weekly/` (`Weekly 25` renamed `Week 25`), 3 monthly folders under `Monthly/`, 3 traffic-assessment files under `Traffic Change Assessment/`, and the stray `Weekly Plan - Weeks (27-28).eml` filed in `Weekly/Week 27/`. 7. Month folders standardized: `June 26` and `July 26` are now `Jun 26` and `Jul 26` in Production report, Survey Data, Maintenance Schedules and Maaden Plans. 8. Kept as-is because scheduled tasks hard-code them: Production report, Survey Data, Grade Control & Stockpiles, FCST, Meeting Notes, Notes & References, Important References, HOD Meetings, Notion Projects, Project Finances, Production Vision 2025, CIP, HR. 9. Citations and tooling updated (1,137 path rewrites in 42 files) `RAW/_INGESTED.md` (835 rewrites), 22 Wiki articles, 5 Outputs reports, this KB's `CLAUDE.md` (new "RAW Folder Layout" section), 6 project briefs, and 9 generator scripts (`publish_insights.py` and `build_visual_report.py` read the workshop folder by path; the rest only mention paths in labels). Pre-edit copies are in `_TIDY_HOLD/2026-10-02-restructure/backup/`. Integrity check: 355 registry rows point at a path that does not exist, identical to the count before the restructure (older rows for files later moved into sub-folders). No row broke and none were repaired. Older CHANGELOG entries, project memory logs and EOD summaries were left as written; use `PATH-MAP.md` to translate their paths. The A&U refresh, Broken Stock dashboard and Mining kb afternoon compile tasks only name folders that did not change, so they needed no edit. Tasks stored only on Peter's Mac were not visible from this session and were not checked. Watch for Anyone or any automation dropping files into the old folder names (for example a new `Week 41` under `Maaden Plans/`, or the Oct 26 workshop sheets into `Maintanance Shedules`) will recreate the old folder. The next compile pass reads by mtime, so it still sees them, but they would need moving. `Wiki/weekly-mining-plan.md` mentions a Deck Archive subfolder that was moved to hold earlier today.
